findings.mechanism: Untrusted request.category is trimmed by categoryName and concatenated by categoryScope into a quoted SQL predicate, then executed in the WHERE clause without a bound parameter.
findings.impact: An attacker controlling request.category can inject SQL syntax into the categorySnapshot query, altering filtering or executing unintended SQL depending on SQLite statement behavior.

ordinary_reread_reasons: All other supplied sites use fixed SQL with named bound values.
inventoryList appends only stockOrder outputs from a finite allowlist.
send is called with a fixed SQL string in the observed caller.
limits: Audit unavailable; triage limited to the supplied site set.
